intro hfg
rw [ModularForm.coe_mul]
intros hf' hg'
contrapose! hfg
apply not_not
intro h
have h0 : ⇑f * ⇑g = 0 := by rw [h, ModularForm.one_coe_eq_one, mul_one]
cases (hf : f ≠ 0) with hfx
cases (hg : g ≠ 0) with hgx
obtain ⟨h, h0⟩ := h0
have h0' : ⇑f = 0 := by rw [h0, hfx, eq_false]
have h0'' : ⇑g = 0 := by rw [h0, hgx, eq_false]
exact false.elim h0' h0''
